headline: Every game now has a details view.
highlights: 'Open Details' on any game to see when you first and last played it and everything PlayCounter knows about it from IGDB.
'Now Playing' got a fresh look with the cover art as backdrop, and picking the right game when PlayCounter is unsure is now a matter of one click on a cover.
Two new options under Customize in My Games: 'Sharper covers' loads cover art at a higher quality, and 'Hide empty library tabs' removes Steam and Xbox tabs you never imported into.

headline: Another Hotfix for v1.1.12!
highlights: Existing approved game-file matches found during a library import are now applied directly, without showing Level up or repeating approval notifications.
Importing a game no longer counts an already reviewed database match as a new community contribution or achievement.

headline: Hotfix for v1.1.12.
highlights: Fixed the Xbox History to use a different tooling to read Xbox Game History to solve a problem regarding false positives.

headline: Bring your Xbox library and playtime into PlayCounter.
highlights: Import your Xbox play history with Microsoft sign-in in your browser, then match it with games installed through the Xbox app on this PC.
Review uncertain Xbox matches before importing and choose the correct game file when PlayCounter needs help identifying what to track.
My Games now has dedicated Steam and Xbox views, clearer imported-game states, and a Back to top button for large libraries.
Customize the My Games summary cards and choose which origin and match markers appear on game cards. Your view choices are remembered.
Open launchable games in File Explorer from their context menu, and control whether PlayCounter remembers local launch paths independently of the Play button.
Steam games can be imported again to refresh playtime, while improved game-file matching, system-process filtering, and provider and emulator icons keep your library more accurate.

headline: Bring your Steam library into PlayCounter.
highlights: Small hotfix for 1.1.10.
Fixed an bug for steam imported games, that were suggested to the community database and got accepted and where the upgrade option didn't work properly.
Next you will find the changelog for 1.1.10 again:
Import your local Steam library and historical playtime directly from the Steam tab in My Games.
The importer guides you through choosing a Steam account and selecting the games you want to add.
Click anywhere on a game row to select it, making large imports much faster.
Steam scans now show clear loading feedback while games and executable matches are being discovered.
Check for executable matches on Steam-imported games that do not have a known executable yet.
Improved Steam library path detection, imported-game rendering, and support for opening non-installed games in Steam.

headline: Launch your Dolphin and DOSBox games straight from PlayCounter.
highlights: On Windows, tracked Dolphin and DOSBox games can now be launched from My Games or their emulator page.
PlayCounter can learn emulator programs and game files as you play, or you can choose them yourself when a path cannot be detected.
Emulator launch files now have their own controls in Settings, so you can change an emulator program or forget emulator paths without affecting regular game executables.
A manually selected executable can now launch a regular game even when its filename differs from the one PlayCounter originally tracked.
Games sorted by Last Played no longer jump as you click Play, and refreshed session notifications are clearer and remain visible longer.

headline: Launch your games from PlayCounter and navigate from the couch.
highlights: On Windows, you can now launch tracked games directly from My Games. PlayCounter learns local program files as you play, or you can choose one yourself; saved paths never leave your PC.
Optional controller navigation lets you browse PlayCounter and start games with Xbox-style button guidance, including a shortcut to bring the app to the front.
My Games now includes a larger card layout, clearer Play actions, launch progress feedback, and protection against starting multiple games at once.
Pending community game suggestions can now be cancelled without removing your private game, playtime, or history. Suggestions supported by other players remain in review.
Dialogs, tours, contribution controls, and wording have been refined for a more consistent and natural experience.

headline: Community-powered emulator matching gets smarter.
highlights: You can now share emulator game matches for review, helping PlayCounter recognize the same games for everyone.
Track the status of your emulator suggestions through notifications and unlock new contribution achievements when they are approved.
A new emulator guide, better game suggestions, and a refreshed Now Emulating screen make emulator tracking easier to set up and use.
History sessions are easier and safer to manage with keyboard navigation and a confirmation step before deletion.
Fixed an issue that prevented playtime from being edited for custom games.

headline: Guided tours make PlayCounter easier to learn.
highlights: New guided tours walk you through the main screens and common tasks. Step through them with the arrow keys.
The emulator game picker now stays open until you finish choosing.
Now Playing cards no longer jump out of order when a game starts or stops.
Restoring a backup is quieter and more reliable when you move your data to another PC.
